config.source: Genuine external host effects only; all 51 initial state words may be loaded once. Dynamic source/FIFO/filter/PCM assertion state is never translated to cfg.

packet.values: Selected 22 PC fields only, u32 in increasing mask-bit order; two lanes per u64, odd upper lane zero.
packet.order: Strictly increasing (voice,stage), at most one packet per hook; pure no-op hooks omitted. A validated later packet or payload exhaustion supplies zero-mask no-terminal to the actual requested hook; stale or unconsumed packet faults.
packet.validation: All header/count/length/padding/word-width/PC-mask/hold/stage/terminal checks; DMA error faults. No successful affected frame publication.

ownership: Prefetched bytes never advance voice state. Configuration is applied from audio due before ascending voice issue. Hook packets are consumed only by current xp3_parameter_voice request.
reset: Clear ownership, drain shared accepted bursts, then reuse raw RAM. No raw RAM clear is required.
